name: MCMC Densification
definition: A Bayesian densification strategy that reformulates Gaussian Splatting densification as a Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamic (SGLD) update rule, adding noise to center locations.
summary: MCMC Densification is a Bayesian strategy for 3D Gaussian Splatting that uses Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics to add noise to Gaussian centers, reducing reliance on initial point clouds and allowing pre-specified target densities.
